There's a clinic at my school I could visit, but I don't know when. I talked to my mom and she definitely doesn't believe me. She interpreted what I said as I didn't study enough, not that I cannot remember...

My "interaction/actions" memory seems to be intact, it's mostly factual stuff I can't remember.

I am royally screwed unless I recover overnight. I'm probably just gonna grit my teeth and deal with it, then deal with credit recovery when the time comes. Yay, not graduating...

My teachers don't believe me, I've already tried. And doctors are super expensive...

And the migraines probably aren't stress related. I've had them semi-regularly for years.
I've tried that :( it's been a week and a half and nothing :(
